column1: # The releases at which the bash check of each rule changed, read by tests/releases.rs and by
# scripts/check-parity.sh. One row per rule of nuc, four or five fields separated by tabs: the rule
# ID; the script of the template that holds its bash check; the function of that script, or "-"
# for the whole script; the template releases of the corpus at which that check changed, the
# earliest pinned release of the template left out, separated by commas, or "-" for none; and,
# for a rule that checks every release alike although its bash changed, the reason; a reason
# that opens with 'vX.Y.Z[,vX.Y.Z...]:' covers only those releases. The parity harness compares
# each function across the trees of the template in the corpus, comment lines left out, and fails
# where this table says otherwise. tests/releases.rs fails on a rule whose check changed at a
# release no reason covers and that does not read the release the tree carries (ADR-0023).
# Only the named function is compared: a change to a helper it calls or a global it reads, as
# placeholder or add_error, shows in no row, and is found by reading the release's diff.
